content.summary: Three constructive checks confirm that the existing text and companion retain the distinctions exposed by committed Beta controls. I tested shorter or more explicit formulations without editing the manuscript. They are optional explanatory improvements, not necessary mathematical corrections. No new required revision arises from this scope.

findings.statement: A trace-cap parenthesis, an explicit deletion-set inclusion formula and a two-line hub contradiction could reduce reader effort.
findings.disposition: These are optional: section 3.1 and the mapped companion already supply the multiplicity and inclusion obligations, while section 6 supplies sufficient inequalities. No missing premise was found.

revisions.result: Their quantifiers remain explicit and agree with the tested examples.

revisions.action: Followed the mapped fibre and deletion obligations.
revisions.result: The precise set-inclusion and B4 conditions are recoverable from their named sources.
Maximum-degree selection still precedes the cap-5 branches.

checks.method: Rebuilt Beta round7 trace control with literal sets; inspected D19-model-bridge.md section 2 and degree19_projection_v5.py line 71 against manuscript 3.1.
checks.observation: The 21-member SF4 example has complete root degree 19 and two completions of trace 067. All 1330 member triples avoid sunflowers. The model bounds trace sizes 0–4 by 49,19,6,2,1. An optional clarification, “multiplicities subject to degree/codegree bounds,” is accurate; binary proper traces would be false. The current count definition and four-point qualification already preserve this distinction.

checks.scope: Deletion-cover obligation expressed through actual sets.
checks.method: Rebuilt Beta round3 three-member control; read D16-fibre-independent-preparation.md, Exact down-set inequality, and d16_fibre_reconstruction.cpp lines 126–131.
checks.observation: Mapping A=0123, B=0456, Q=1789 to fibres 0,1,6 preserves disjointness edges. D3={A} and D6={B} have equal cardinality, yet Q misses undeleted B. The implemented occupied-neighbour mask inclusion is therefore essential. Adding the formula summing over D_j subset D_i to section 5.1 would help orientation, but the existing obligation map already identifies its exact derivation.

checks.scope: A shorter explicit final hub contradiction.
checks.method: Read LOW15-R15-hub-deletion-exclusion.md, Literal B4 equality guard through The one-unit contradiction; inspected R15ScalarClosure.lean lines 24–58 and independently enumerated the bounded deficit interface.
checks.observation: There are 50 relaxed states; dropping any one of the three equality guards leaves three states, while the strict system has none. After the geometric guards establish Y+3<=2a+b, the displayed inequalities imply a+t>=4 and 2(a+t)<=7. This valid optional two-line ending preserves every premise and does not replace the B4 proof with arithmetic alone.
